# `aitbc network peers`

List connected peers and basic peer information.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc network peers [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--rpc-url` | text | `http://localhost:8202` | no | Blockchain RPC URL <!-- check-ports: ignore --> |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc network peers
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc network peers --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
